title: 第8章 逻辑与辩证唯物主义

zh: 第8章 逻辑与辩证唯物主义
en: Chapter 8: LOGIC AND DIALECTICAL MATERIALISM

zh: 黑格尔与逻辑
……把三段论仅仅看作由三个判断构成，是一种形式主义观点；它忽视了各个规定之间的关系，而推理所涉及的恰恰只是这种关系。把各项之间的联系拆分为孤立的前提和与这些前提相区别的结论，完全是一种纯粹主观的反思：
en: . . . to regard the syllogism as merely consisting

is a formalistic view that ignores the relation of the determinations which alone is at issue in the inference. It is altogether a merely subjective reflection that splits the connection of the terms into isolated premises and a conclusion distinct from them:

zh: 所有人都会死。盖乌斯是人。因此盖乌斯会死。
en: All humans are mortal. Gaius is a human. Therefore Gaius is mortal.

zh: 一听到这种推理被搬出来，人立刻就会感到厌倦。这种厌倦来自一种形式的徒劳：它通过彼此分离的命题制造出多样性的幻象，而这种幻象在事实本身中立即消解了。G. 黑格尔，《逻辑学》
en: One is immediately seized by boredom the moment one hears this inference being trotted out, a boredom brought on by the futility of a form that, by means of separate propositions, gives the illusion of a diversity which is immediately dissolved in the fact itself. G. Hegel,

zh: 格奥尔格·黑格尔（1770—1831）的唯心主义在欧洲哲学中占据核心地位。英国传统在复兴逻辑之前先与亚里士多德决裂；与之不同，辩证法处于黑格尔认识论的核心。
en: The idealism of Georg Hegel (1770–1831) is central to European philosophy. Unlike the British tradition, which broke with Aristotle before reviving logic, dialectics is at the heart of Hegel’s epistemology.

zh: 从亚里士多德的视角看，黑格尔著作《逻辑学》
的书名似乎有些奇怪。亚里士多德把辩证法与科学相对置，认为它是一种说服形式，而非自主理解世界如何运行的途径；他也把辩证法与三段论逻辑相对置，认为它是前提的来源，而非对这些前提进行推理的方法。尽管如此，黑格尔确实认为逻辑可以得到科学阐释，这一点仍有益处。
en: The title of Hegel’s book

seems strange from an Aristotelian perspective. Aristotle counterpoises dialectics to science, as a form of persuasion rather than an autonomous way of understanding how the world works, and to syllogistic logic, as a source of premises rather than a method for reasoning about them. Still, it is salutary that Hegel does view logic as being amenable to scientific exegesis.

zh: 黑格尔对把三段论的形式与其应用语境相分离的价值深表怀疑。也就是说，三段论本身并无意趣。其重要性在于它如何将特定前提（规定）与特定结论联系起来，而这些联系又依赖先前的推理来确立前提之间的关系。正如我们将看到的，这种态度是辩证唯物主义中反复出现的特征。
en: Hegel was highly sceptical about the value of separating the form of a syllogism from its context of application. That is, the syllogism itself is of no interest. Rather, its importance lies in how it connects particular premises (determinations) to particular conclusions, which in turn depend on prior reasoning to establish relationships among premises. As we shall see, this attitude is a recurrent feature of dialectical materialism.

zh: 尽管如此，黑格尔确实系统地探讨了三段论的各种形式，
并借助辩证转化来考察它们之间的关系。不过，他除以普遍（U）、单称（S）或特称（P）来标记三段论中的项之外，并未采用其他形式记号；这比早先的做法更为简化。与前人一样，黑格尔运用了简洁的论证和例子。
en: Nonetheless, Hegel does systematically explore the syllogistic forms,

and considers how they relate to each other using dialectical transformations. But he deploys no formal notation other than denoting the terms in syllogisms as universal (U), singular (S) or particular (P), a simplification of the earlier practice. Like his predecessors, Hegel uses terse arguments and examples.

zh: 《逻辑学》的序言进一步阐明了黑格尔对三段论逻辑的态度。首先，他指出科学和常识已经取代形而上学，也取代了“逻辑教人如何思考”这一观念。尽管如此，逻辑仍被保留在诸科学之中，“大概是为了某种形式上的效用”，虽然“它的形式和内容在漫长的传承中始终未变”（第8页）。
en: Hegel’s attitude towards syllogistic logic is further illuminated in the
to

. First of all, he noted that science and commonsense had displaced metaphysics, as well as the notion that logic taught one how to think. Nonetheless, logic was retained among the sciences ‘probably for the sake of a certain formal utility’, though ‘its shape and content have remained the same throughout a long inherited tradition’ (p8).

zh: 对黑格尔而言，思想蕴含于语言之中，语言的形式决定思想；在这方面，德语显然更胜一筹（！）（《第二版序言》，第12页）。而且，逻辑在人类境况中占据核心地位：
en: For Hegel, thought is held in language and the form of language determines thought, for which German is clearly superior(!) (
, p12). And logic is central to the human condition:

zh: 逻辑对人来说是如此自然，甚至就是人的本性。但是，如果我们将自然本身，即物理领域，与精神领域相对置，那么就必须说：逻辑是贯穿人一切自然行为——感知、直观、欲求的方式，以及需要和冲动——的超自然要素；它由此使这些行为成为真正属人的东西，尽管还只是形式上属人的东西，使之成为表象和目的。（第12页）
en: So much is logic natural to the human being, is indeed his very
. If we however contrast

as such, as the realm of the physical, with the realm of the spiritual, then we must say that logic is the supernatural element that permeates all his natural behavior, his ways of sensing, intuiting, desiring, his needs and impulses; and it thereby makes them into something truly human, even though only formally human – makes them into representations and purposes. (p12)

zh: 在这里，他明确反对亚里士多德的立场：
en: Here, he explicitly disagrees with Aristotle’s position:

zh: 亚里士多德在同一语境中说：“人的本性在如此多的方面都处于束缚之中；但这门并非为任何效用而追求的科学，独自是自在自为地自由的，因而似乎并非人所能拥有。”（第14页，引用亚里士多德《形而上学》982b）
en: ‘In so many respects’, says Aristotle in the same context, ‘is human nature in bondage; but this science, which is not pursued for any utility, is alone free in and for itself, and for this reason it appears not to be a human possession’. (p14, citing Aristotle,

zh: 黑格尔则认为，恰恰相反，逻辑关乎抽象思维，所以先教给年轻人，具体事务则留待以后。且不论黑格尔未能意识到这种教育是何等的特权，他在这里反映了“三艺”与“四艺”的区分，这种区分当时想必仍然通行。
en: Hegel argues that, on the contrary, logic is about abstract thought which is why it is taught to young people, with concrete matters coming later. Here, quite apart from Hegel’s unawareness of how privileged such education was, he reflects the distinction between the Trivium and Quadrivium, which must have still been current.

zh: 对黑格尔而言，逻辑的一大益处，是其普遍性使它能够发挥简约表达的作用。然而，脱离内容的逻辑无法达到真理，因此常识将其视为贫瘠无物而加以拒斥，也就不足为奇了：
en: For Hegel, a major benefit of logic lies in its utility as an abbreviation because of its universality. However, because logic shorn of content cannot attain truth, it is hardly surprising that it has been rejected by common sense as barren:

zh: 对于规定推理规则的公式而言——推理实际上是知性的一项主要功能——健全的常识忽视了这些公式在认识中有其位置、必须得到遵守，并且是理性思维必不可少的材料；无论这种忽视多么错误，常识同样正确地认识到：这些公式不加区分地既为谬误服务，也为诡辩服务；无论如何定义真理，就更高的真理，例如宗教真理而言，它们都毫无用处。总的说来，它们只涉及知识的正确性，而不涉及知识的真理性。（第18页）
en: Regarding the formulas that define the rules of inference which in fact is a principal function of the understanding, however mistaken healthy common sense might be in ignoring that they have their place in cognition where they must be obeyed, and also that they are essential material for rational thought, it has nonetheless come to the equally correct realisation that such formulas are indifferently at the service just as much of error as of sophistry, and that, however truth may be defined, so far as higher truth is concerned, for instance religious truth, they are useless – that in general they have to do only with the correctness of knowledge, not its truth. (p18)

zh: 在这里，黑格尔的立场令人想起霍布斯。
en: Here, Hegel’s position is reminiscent of Hobbes’.

zh: 黑格尔认为，形式与内容的分离是一种幻象。他在《导言》中进一步详述了这一立场。辩证唯物主义拒斥形式主义，即脱离内容独立研究逻辑的根源，便在于此。
en: Hegel argues that the separation of form and content is illusory. He goes on to considerably expand on this position in the
. Herein lie the roots of the rejection of formalism, that is, the study of logic independently of content, in dialectical materialism.

zh: 恩格斯与逻辑
卡尔·马克思（1818—1883）和弗里德里希·恩格斯（1820—1895）的革命世界观以科学唯物主义为前提。马克思几乎没有论述辩证法或三段论逻辑。相比之下，恩格斯在晚期著作中多次提及逻辑。在1877年的《反杜林论》
中，他有力地断言：逻辑在与辩证法的结合中处于从属地位。首先，他重申亚里士多德的立场：一门科学一旦充分专门化，就会独立于任何范围更广的认识论。三段论逻辑——现在称为形式逻辑——以及辩证法，作为思维规律，独立于哲学：
en: The revolutionary world view of Karl Marx (1818–83) and Frederic Engels (1820– 95) is premised on scientific materialism. Marx wrote practically nothing about dialectics or syllogistic logic. Engels, in contrast, made a number of references to logic in his later work. In

from 1877, he strongly asserted the subordination of logic in its union with dialectics. First of all, he reasserts Aristotle’s position that, once a science is sufficiently specialized, it becomes independent of any wider epistemology. Syllogistic logic, now termed formal, and dialectics, as the laws of thought, are independent of philosophy:

zh: 在以往全部哲学中，还独立存在着的，就是关于思维及其规律的科学——形式逻辑和辩证法。其余一切都归入关于自然和历史的实证科学。（第40页）
en: That which still survives, independently, of all earlier philosophy is the science of thought and its laws — formal logic and dialectics. Everything else is subsumed in the positive science of nature and history. (p40)

zh: 这一表述在1880年的《社会主义从空想到科学的发展》
中得到重复，并在1886年的《路德维希·费尔巴哈和德国古典哲学的终结》
中再次重申。
en: This formulation was repeated in the 1880
and reiterated in 1886 in

children: Ludwig Feuerbach and the End of Classical German Philosophy.

zh: 回到《反杜林论》，恩格斯指出，数学必须从逻辑中借用公理，而这些公理是“最贫乏的思想内容的表达”（第60页）。他沿袭黑格尔的观点说，仅靠逻辑公理“收效甚微”，要取得进展就必须借助几何学（第61页）。他的主要批评是，杜林强调纯数学独立于经验，却不承认它是从现实中抽象出来的（第61页）。
en: Returning to

, Engels argues that mathematics has to borrow axioms from logic, which are ‘expressions of the scantiest thought-content’ (p60). Following Hegel, he says that logical axioms alone ‘do not cut much ice’, and to make progress it is necessary to draw on geometry (p61). His main plaint is that Dühring emphasizes the independence of pure mathematics from experience rather than acknowledging its abstraction from reality (p61).

zh: 恩格斯说，辩证法比形式逻辑更有力：
en: Engels says that dialectics is more powerful than formal logic:

zh: 就连形式逻辑也首先是一种获得新结果、从已知推进到未知的方法；辩证法也是如此，而且更为显著。此外，由于辩证法突破了形式逻辑的狭隘视野，它包含着一种更全面的世界观的萌芽。（第186页）
en: Even formal logic is primarily a method of arriving at new results, of advancing from the known to the unknown – and dialectics is the same, only much more eminently so; moreover, since it forces its way beyond the narrow horizon of formal logic, it contains the germ of a more comprehensive view of the world. (p186).

zh: 此外，形式逻辑只对初等数学具有意义。在高等数学中，乃至一切新科学中，都需要辩证法才能取得进展：
en: Further, formal logic is only significant for elementary mathematics. In higher mathematics, indeed, in all new science, dialectics is needed to advance:

zh: 初等数学，即常量的数学，至少总体上是在形式逻辑的范围内活动的；变量的数学，其最重要的部分是微积分，本质上无非是辩证法在数学关系中的应用。在这里，与这一方法在新研究领域中的多种应用相比，单纯的证明问题显然退居次要地位。但是，几乎所有高等数学的证明，从微分学最初的证明起，从初等数学的立场看，严格说来都是错误的。当人们像这里一样，试图用形式逻辑来证明在辩证法领域中获得的结果时，这就是必然的。（第186—187页）
en: Elementary mathematics, the mathematics of constant quantities, moves within the confines of formal logic, at any rate on the whole; the mathematics of variables, whose most important part is the infinitesimal calculus, is in essence nothing other than the application of dialectics to mathematical relations. In it, the simple question of proof is definitely pushed into the background, as compared with the manifold application of the method to new spheres of research. But almost all the proofs of higher mathematics, from the first proofs of the differential calculus on, are from the standpoint of elementary mathematics strictly speaking, wrong. And this is necessarily so, when, as happens in this case, an attempt is made to prove by formal logic results obtained in the field of dialectics. (p186–7)

zh: 然而，他把形式逻辑描述为涉及常量而非变量，这表明他存在根本性的误解。马克思对数学也持这种看法，下文将会谈到。恩格斯还流露出一种奇特的对数学的蔑视：
en: Nonetheless, his characterization of formal logic involving constants rather than variables suggests a fundamental misunderstanding. This was also Marx’s view of mathematics, as shall see below. And Engels betrayed a curious contempt for mathematics:

zh: 然而，数学家的抽象要求远不是现实世界必须遵守的规律。（第75页）
en: The abstract requirement of a mathematician is, however, far from being a compulsory law for the world of reality. (p75)

zh: 最后，在他身后出版的《自然辩证法》
中，恩格斯重谈这些主题。他再次认为，辩证逻辑优于形式逻辑，因为它把分析与推理结合起来：
en: Finally, in the posthumously published
Engels revisited these themes. Once again, dialectical logic is superior to formal logic, because it integrates both analysis and reasoning:

zh: 辩证逻辑与旧的、纯形式的逻辑不同：它不像后者那样，满足于列举思维的运动形式，即各种判断形式和结论形式，并把它们毫无联系地并列起来。相反，它使这些形式彼此推导出来，使一种形式从属于另一种形式，而不是把它们置于同等地位；它从较低的形式发展出较高的形式。（第296页）
en: Dialectical logic, in contrast to the old, merely formal logic, is not, like the latter, content with enumerating the forms of motion of thought, ie the various forms of judgment and conclusion, and placing them side by side without any connection. On the contrary, it derives these forms out of one another, it makes one subordinate to another instead of putting them on an equal level, it develops the higher forms out of the lower. (p296)

zh: 恩格斯承认，尽管自然科学和历史科学不断发展，形式逻辑仍有一种本质性的、可以认识的特性。尽管如此，他又一次坚决拒斥数学抽象：
en: Engels acknowledges that, despite developments in natural and historical sciences, formal logic has an essential and knowable quality. Nonetheless, once again, Engels firmly rejects mathematical abstraction:

zh: 他们［数学家和自然科学家］指责黑格尔所做的事，即把抽象推到极端，他们自己却在大得多的规模上这样做。他们忘记了，全部所谓纯数学都涉及抽象，严格说来，它的一切量都是想象的；而一切抽象一旦推到极端，就会转化为无稽之谈，或转化为自身的对立面。（第359页）
en: What they [mathematicians and natural scientists] charge Hegel with doing, viz., pushing abstractions to the extreme limit, they do themselves on a far greater scale. They forget that the whole of so-called pure mathematics is concerned with abstractions, that all its magnitudes, strictly speaking, are imaginary, and that all abstractions when pushed to extremes are transformed into nonsense or into their opposite. (p359)

zh: 在《自然辩证法》的笔记中，恩格斯区分了可以通过“物质直观”来证明的数学运算，以及只能通过演绎来证明的逻辑推演：
en: In his notes for
, Engels distinguishes between mathematical operations, which could be proved by ‘material contemplation’, and logical deductions, which could only be proved by deduction:

zh: 计算的理性——计算机器！——一种奇特的混淆：把数学运算与纯粹逻辑运算混在一起。数学运算可以作物质性的演示和证明，因为它们以直接的、即使是抽象的物质直观为基础；纯粹逻辑运算则只能通过演绎来证明，因而不可能具有数学运算所具有的确实性——而其中又有多少是错误的！积分机；参见安德鲁斯的演讲，《自然》，9月7日，76.317。
en: Calculative reason – calculating machine! – Curious confusion of mathematical operations, which are capable of material demonstration, of proof because they are based on direct, even if abstract, material contemplation, with purely logical ones, which are capable only of proof by deduction, hence are incapable of the positive certainty possessed by mathematical operations—and how many of them wrong! Machine for integration; cf. Andrews’ speech, Nature, Sept. 7, 76.317

zh: 无限的本性也曾是恩格斯和杜林共同关心的问题。康托尔曾颇不耐烦地驳斥杜林关于无限的论述。
恩格斯也长篇批评了杜林的无限概念。不过，恩格斯把可数性与计数混淆了：
en: The nature of infinity had also concerned both Engels and Dühring. Dühring’s writings about infinity, were rather tetchily dismissed by Cantor.
Engels, in turn, criticized at length Dühring’s notion of infinity. However, Engels confuses countabilty with counting:

zh: 可是，“已经数过的无限数列”这个矛盾又该如何解释呢？只要杜林先生为我们表演一下把它数完的巧妙把戏，我们就能够更仔细地考察这个问题了。
en: But what of the contradiction of ‘the counted infinite numerical series’? We shall be in a position to examine this more closely as soon as Herr Dühring has performed for us the clever trick of counting it.

zh: 狄慈根、辩证唯物主义与逻辑
约瑟夫·狄慈根（1828—1888）在1848年德国革命期间结识马克思，后来成为他的朋友。狄慈根自学成才，恩格斯在《路德维希·费尔巴哈和德国古典哲学的终结》中肯定他独立发现了唯物辩证法。请留意“唯物辩证法”这一表述。它听起来像是一种以唯物主义为基础的辩证法，但这不排除唯物主义也能为其他分析方式提供基础。因此，我们可以承认一种非辩证的唯物主义科学。
en: Joseph Dietzgen (1828–88) met Marx during the 1848 German Revolution, and subsequently became his friend. Self-educated, Engels credited him, in

children: Ludwig Fuerbach and the end of Classical German Philosophy

en: , with independently discovering the materialist dialectic. Note the formulation ‘materialist dialectic’. This sounds like a form of dialectic grounded in materialism. But this does not exclude materialism grounding other modes of analysis. So, we may admit a non-dialectical materialist science.

zh: 伯恩斯
认为，狄慈根阅读恩格斯关于费尔巴哈的论述后，在1887年的《一个社会主义者在认识论领域的漫游》
中创用了“辩证唯物主义”一词。
这个看似琐碎的细节，凸显了这些概念的含义是多么游移不定。
en: Burns
argues that Dietzgen coined the expression ‘dialectical materialism’, having read Engels on Feurbach in his

children: Excursions of a Socialist into the Domain of Epistemology

en: from 1887.
This apparent point of trivia highlights how slippery these notions are.

zh: “辩证唯物主义”听起来像是一种以辩证法为基础的唯物主义，也就是不承认其他分析形式的唯物主义。正如我们将看到的，在后来的马克思主义哲学中，辩证法与科学越来越被混为一谈，二者能够彼此分离的说法也遭到争辩。不明确宣称自己具有辩证性质的科学唯物主义，则被称为机械唯物主义。
en: ‘Dialectical materialism’ sounds like a variety of materialism that is grounded in dialectics, that is, one which admits no other forms of analysis. As we shall see, dialectics and science are increasingly conflated in subsequent Marxist philosophy, and it was disputed that one could be separated from the other. Scientific materialism that was not avowedly dialectical was termed

zh: 狄慈根在最成熟的著作《哲学的积极成果》
中，把形式逻辑的前提与从这些前提作出的推演混淆了。他又把批评前提与批评推演混淆起来：
en: In his most mature work,
Dietzgen conflated the premises of formal logic with the deductions made from them. He further confuses critiquing premises with critiquing the deduction:

zh: 他据以推断狗一般具有警觉性的前提，是由传统传下来的，并凭信念得到接受。但它有事实根据吗？难道不会有一些狗缺少警觉性吗？即便所有推演都很严密，我们的巴哥犬难道不可能很不可靠吗？（XIII）
en: The premise from which he deducted the watchfulness of dogs in general, was handed down by tradition and had been accepted on faith. But was it founded on fact? Could there not be some dogs who lacked the quality of watchfulness, and might not our pug-dog be very unreliable, in spite of all exact deductions? (XIII)

zh: 狄慈根接着引用培根（以及笛卡尔）对三段论逻辑的拒斥。与黑格尔一样，这里需要的是逻辑与辩证法的一种新综合。
en: Dietzgen goes on to cite Bacon’s (and Descartes’) rejection of syllogistic logic. As with Hegel, what is needed is a new synthesis of logic and dialectics.

zh: 狄慈根的长处在于明确揭示了辩证法的阶级视角，尤其是在较早写给儿子的书信集《逻辑书简，特别是民主的无产阶级的逻辑》
中。在这里，他批评阶级（即资产阶级）逻辑通过强调差异，将剥削合理化为自然现象。这使狄慈根把形式逻辑与阶级逻辑联系起来，因为形式逻辑把前提当作事物彼此分离的方面，并据此推理。不过，他以一种明确的先验论证，拒斥了第二条思维规律，即矛盾表明前提无效。
en: Dietzgen’s great strength lies in making explicit the class perspective of dialectics, in particular in an earlier collection of letters to his son,

children: Letters on Logic Especially Democratic-Proletarian Logic.

en: Here, he criticizes class (i.e. bourgeoisie) logic for rationalizing exploitation as natural, by emphasizing difference. This leads Dietzgen to associate formal logic with class logic because it is based on reasoning from premises as separate aspects of things. However, he rejects the second law of thought, that contradictions demonstrate invalid premises, in an argument that is explicitly transcendental.

zh: 狄慈根呼应黑格尔的观点，对逻辑学家不屑一顾，因为他们将逻辑与其内容割裂开来：
en: Echoing Hegel, Dietzgen has no time for logicians, because they separate logic from its content:

zh: 形式逻辑学家既无知又狡黠。他们坚持用传统方式讨论知性或思维，仿佛它们是孤立的东西，却无视逻辑研究的对象与经验世界之间的必然联系。这种相互联系会引向对真理与谬误、意义与无意义、神与偶像的说明，而这对教授们来说很不合时宜。因此，这个不受欢迎的问题被移交给神秘的部门——形而上学和宗教——好让这些官方智慧的尊贵支柱继续为统治阶级效劳。（第四封信）
en: The formal logicians are as ignorant as they are roguish, when they persist in discussing the intellect or thought in the traditional manner as if they were isolated things, while ignoring the necessary connection of the object of the logical study with the world of experiences. This interconnection leads to an explanation of truth and error, of sense and nonsense, of god and idols, and this is very inopportune for the professors. For this reason this unwelcome problem is handed over to the mystical departments, to metaphysics and religion, so that these venerable pillars of official wisdom may continue their services to the ruling classes. (Fourth Letter)

zh: 在《逻辑书简》的开头部分，狄慈根用陶工的类比来拒斥形式逻辑，认为思想不能与行动分离，形式也不能与内容分离。在这里，他似乎忘记了马克思在《资本论》第一卷中的著名论断。
en: Early on in

, Dietzgen deploys an analogy of a potter to reject formal logic, saying that thoughts cannot be separated from actions, nor form from content. Here, Dietzgen seems to forget Marx’s famous observation in
Volume 1.

zh: 但是，最蹩脚的建筑师与最灵巧的蜜蜂之间的区别在于：建筑师在现实中建造之前，已经在想象中建成了他的建筑。（第174页）
en: But what distinguishes the worst architect from the best of bees is this, that the architect raises his structure in imagination before he erects it in reality. (p174)

zh: 狄慈根熟悉亚里士多德的三段论逻辑，合理地批评它无法充分把握事物多方面的属性。然而，他援引自己的革命原则，在后来的《哲学的积极成果》中说：
en: Familiar with Aristotelian syllogistic logic, Dietzgen makes the reasonable criticism that it could not adequately capture multifaceted properties of things. However, invoking his revolutionary principles, he says in the later

zh: 哲学家们应当放弃试图用三段论证明任何事物的老嗜好。如今，一个论点并非靠言辞，而是靠事实、靠行动来证实。各门科学已充分具备所需的条件，因此“理解的可能性”得到了无可置疑的证明。（XIII）
en: The philosophers should abandon their old hobby of trying to prove anything by syllogisms. Nowadays, a case is not substantiated by words, but by facts, by deeds. The sciences are sufficiently equipped, and thus the ‘possibility of understanding’ is demonstrated beyond a doubt. (XIII)

zh: 虽然狄慈根已不再属于马克思主义主流经典，但在布尔什维克革命之前，他曾有很大影响。安东·潘涅库克在1902年《脑力劳动的本质》《逻辑书简》和《哲学的积极成果》合订本的导言中写道：
en: While Dietzgen is no longer part of the mainstream Marxist canon, he was highly influential before the Bolshevik revolution. In the introduction to the 1902 combined edition of
and
, Anton Pannekoek wrote:

zh: 深入研究狄慈根的哲学著作，是理解马克思和恩格斯基本著作的重要而不可或缺的辅助。
en: a thorough study of Dietzgen’s philosophical writings is an important and indispensable auxiliary for the understanding of the fundamental works of Marx and Engels.

zh: 我们将考察布尔什维克革命后马克思主义对逻辑的回应，但首先要回过头来看看20世纪初形式逻辑的关键发展。
en: We will explore Marxist responses to logic after the Bolshevik Revolution, but first, we shall backtrack to key developments in formal logic at the start of the twentieth century.

zh: 罗素悖论与《数学原理》
19世纪末，弗雷格的体系被视为形式逻辑的顶峰，正走在数学形式化的康庄大道上。可惜好景不长。1902年，伯特兰·罗素（1872—1970）致信弗雷格，
指出其体系核心存在一个根本矛盾。
en: At the end of the nineteenth century, Frege’s system was seen as the pinnacle of formal logic, on the high road to formalizing mathematics. Alas, this was short lived. In 1902, Bertrand Russell (1872–1970) wrote to Frege,
identifying a fundamental contradiction at the heart of his system.

zh: 在弗雷格的体系中，谓词用满足某种性质的对象所组成的集合来刻画。罗素悖论涉及这样一个观察：谓词可能适用于自身，也可能不适用于自身。等价地说，集合可能以自身为成员，也可能不以自身为成员。
en: In Frege’s system, predicates are characterized by sets of items that satisfy some property. Russell’s paradox involves observing that predicates may or may not apply to themselves. Equivalently, sets may or may not have themselves as members.

zh: 一个适用于自身的谓词，若表示为包含自身的集合，听起来似乎会导致无限展开。然而，使用它的名称而非它的内容，可以避免这种情况。也就是说，看似无限的构造可以有有限的表示。
en: Now, a predicate applying to itself, represented as a set containing itself, sounds like it should lead to an infinite expansion. However, this may be avoided through the use of its name instead of its contents. That is, there are finite representations of apparently infinite constructs.

zh: 考虑那些不包含自身的集合。我们可以构造一个由不包含自身的集合组成的集合。这个集合又不包含自身，因此或许它应当包含自身。但若它被包含在自身之中，它就确实包含自身，于是它又不应当包含自身。
en: Consider sets that don’t contain themselves. We might make a set of sets that do not include themselves. In turn, this set does not include itself, so maybe it should. But if it is included in itself, then it does include itself and so it shouldn’t.

zh: 这不只是一个学术练习；在任何具有文件夹系统的计算机上都能演示它。从文件夹创建指向其他文件夹的链接，是常见的做法。那么，要更方便地从一个大文件夹的底部回到顶部，可以把最后一个条目设为指向该文件夹自身的链接。因此，我们可以新建一个文件夹，其中包含指向那些没有自身链接的文件夹的链接。这个新文件夹应不应该链接到自身呢？
en: This is not merely an academic exercise; we can demonstrate this on any computer with a folder system. It is commonplace to make links from folders to other folders. Then, one way to make it easier to get from the bottom of a large folder back to the top is to make the last entry a link to the folder itself. Thus, we can make a new folder with links to folders that don’t have links to themselves. Should that folder link to itself or not?

zh: 正如弗雷格所承认的，
罗素悖论使在逻辑中将数学形式化的整个前景受到质疑。尽管如此，罗素和他过去的老师阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海（1861—1947）仍着手尝试，将数学系统地建立在一种与弗雷格或康托尔的体系大致等价的形式逻辑之上。三卷本《数学原理》（PM）
于1910年至1913年间出版，重构了数学的重要部分。如今《数学原理》虽很少有人阅读，尤其因为它采用非标准的记号，但它长期以来一直被誉为奠基之作。
en: Russell’s paradox drew into question the whole prospect of formalizing mathematics in logic, as Frege acknowledged.

Nonetheless, Russell, and his former teacher Alfred North Whitehead (1861–1947), embarked on trying to systematically ground mathematics in a formal logic that was broadly equivalent to Frege’s or Cantor’s. The three volumes of
appeared between 1910 and 1913 and reconstructed a significant portion of mathematics. While
is now little read, not least because of its non-standard notation, it has long been heralded as foundational.

zh: 希尔伯特纲领
由大卫·希尔伯特（1862—1943）提出的希尔伯特纲领，规定了20世纪乃至今日形式逻辑研究的框架。这一“纲领”并非像宣言那样，是一份固定的宗旨声明；它是从希尔伯特不断发展的构想中整理出来的。
en: Hilbert’s programme, formulated by David Hilbert (1862–1943), framed the conduct of formal logic in the twentieth century, and to this day. The ‘programme’ was not a settled statement of purpose like a manifesto: rather, it was codified from Hilbert’s evolving conceptions.

zh: 在希尔伯特1904年回应罗素悖论的《论逻辑与算术的基础》

中，可以看到这一纲领的根源。他首先概述主要数学家对数学基础的看法。利奥波德·克罗内克（1823—1891）不诉诸基础，就默认整数存在，被称为教条主义者。赫尔曼·冯·亥姆霍兹（1821—1894）只承认从经验而来的存在，因此排除以思想实验作为理论基础，被称为经验主义者。埃尔温·克里斯托费尔（1829—1900）被称为机会主义者。他虽然反对克罗内克拒斥无理数，但仍寻求接受无理数的肯定性理由。弗雷格的工作被承认为基础性的，却因体系不够严密、导致自指悖论而受到批评。希尔伯特在这里写道：
en: We can see the roots of Hilbert’s programme in his 1904 response to Russell’s paradox,

children: On the foundations of logic and arithmetic.

en: He began by characterizing leading mathematicians’ views on the foundations of mathematics. Leopold Kronecker (1823–91) was called a
for accepting integers as implicitly existent without recourse to foundations. Herman van Helmholtz (1821–94) was termed an
for only accepting existence derived from experience, thus ruling out thought experiments as the basis for theories. Elwin Christoffel (1829– 1900) was termed an

. While he had opposed Kronecker’s rejection of irrational numbers, he sought positive reasons for accepting them. Frege’s work was acknowledged as foundational, but his system was criticized for a lack of rigour, giving rise to paradoxes of self-reference. Here, Hilbert writes:

zh: 相反，从一开始，研究数的概念就应当以避免此类矛盾、澄清这些悖论为主要目标之一。

children: Rather, from the very beginning a major goal of the investigations into the notion of number should be to avoid such contradictions and to clarify these paradoxes.

zh: 希尔伯特接着将理查德·戴德金（1831—1916）的方法描述为先验方法，因为他假定存在由无限多个对象构成的实无限。我们还会回到这一曾受亚里士多德批评的立场。最后，希尔伯特说，康托尔虽然区分了相容的集合与不相容的集合，却没有给出区分标准，因此不得不作主观主义的假定。
en: Hilbert went on to characterize Richard Dedekind (1831–1916) as following a

method, as he assumed actualized infinities of objects. We will return to this position, which Aristotle criticized. Finally, Hilbert said that Cantor, while distinguishing consistent and inconsistent sets, gave no criteria for distinguishing them, necessitating
assumptions.

zh: 希尔伯特在总结这些评论时说，所有这些困难都可以通过他所谓的公理化方法克服。此外，承认逻辑与算术相互依存，并同时发展二者的规律，或许可以避免这些悖论。
en: Hilbert concludes these remarks by saying that all these difficulties could be overcome by what he called the
. Further, the paradoxes might be avoided by acknowledging the co-dependence of logic and arithmetic and concurrently developing their laws.

zh: 形式系统以公理和推理规则为基础。公理是对所有论元都为真的基本公式；推理规则用于从公理和其他定理出发，构造或证明新的真公式，即定理。源于亚里士多德的思维规律，可视为公理的先驱。因此，公理化方法就是寻找一组相互独立的公理，使之连同适当的规则，足以展开某一领域的全部内容。
en: Formal systems are based on
, elementary formulas which are true for all arguments, and
, for constructing or proving
, additional true formula, from
and other
. The Laws of Thought, derived from Aristotle, might be seen as progenitors of
. Then, the axiomatic method involves finding sets of independent
that, together with appropriate rules, are adequate for elaborating all of some domain.

zh: 希尔伯特高度重视公理系统的相容性，即不可能利用这些系统推导出矛盾。不能确立相容性，后来成为数学逻辑危机的关键。
en: Hilbert placed great stress on the
of axiomatic systems, that is, that it should not be possible to use them to derive contradictions. The impossibility of establishing
was to prove key to the later crisis in mathematical logic.

zh: 在后来的一篇论文《公理化思维》
中，希尔伯特首次提到一个“纲领”，
并更详细地阐述自己的目标。除了相容性，他还希望确定任意数学问题在原则上是否可解，能够检验数学活动的结果，并确定是否可能存在更简单的证明。在这里，他也回到那个曾使马克思主义者深感困扰的古老的亚里士多德式问题，即“数学中内容与形式主义的关系”（第1113页）。
en: In a subsequent paper,
Hilbert first referred to a ‘programme’,

developing his objectives in greater detail. As well as consistency, he wished to determine the solvability in principle of arbitrary mathematical questions, to be able to check the results of mathematical activity, and to determine whether or not there might be simpler proofs. Here, Hilbert also returned to the old Aristotelian problem that so exercised Marxists, that of ‘the relationship between
and
in mathematics’ (p1113).

zh: 尤其值得注意的是，能够判定一个数学问题是否可以在有限步骤内求解，
en: Notably, the ability to decide whether or not a mathematical question was solvable in a finite number of steps

zh: ……触及了数学思维的本质。（第1113页）
en: . . . goes to the essence of mathematical thought. (p1113)

zh: 这至今仍通常被称为Entscheidungsproblem，即判定问题。还有许多其他判定问题，例如两个公式是否等价；但能在有限步骤内证明性质，被视为关键。
en: This is still commonly referred to as the
– the decision problem. There are lots of other decision problems, for example, whether or not two formulae are equivalent, but proof of properties in a finite number of steps was seen as key.

zh: 元理论与逻辑学派
希尔伯特认为，数学抽象应当、也能够独立于任何应用内容而得到研究。但希尔伯特纲领要求数学本身也接受数学推理。也就是说，应当有以数学为内容的元数学，但目的仅在于确立公理的相容性。
en: Hilbert thought that mathematical abstractions should, and could, be explored independently of any content of application. But Hilbert’s programme required that mathematics itself should be subject to mathematical reasoning. That is, there should be
, with mathematics as its contents, but only to establish the consistency of axioms.

zh: 数学用语言
来表达，其中有符号、句法和语义。因此，数学将成为自身的元语言，即一种谈论语言的语言。
en: Now, mathematics is expressed in a language,
with symbols, syntax and semantics. Thus, mathematics was to become its own
, a language for talking about language.

zh: 在罗素悖论出现后的数十年中，形式逻辑形成了三个学派，反映出不同的回应。可以根据各派允许哪些数学实体，以及允许针对这些实体进行哪些数学推理，来刻画它们的特点；也就是说，要看它们认为元数学应当如何进行。
这归根结底取决于它们对无限的态度。
en: In the decades following Russell’s paradox, three schools of formal logic emerged, reflecting different responses. We may characterize them according to what they accepted as admissible mathematical entities, and what forms of mathematical reasoning about them were admissible, that is, how meta-mathematics might be conducted.
This boiled down to their attitude to infinity.

zh: 以弗雷格和罗素为代表的逻辑主义者，既接受无限的数学实体，也接受康托尔式的无限推理。他们承认观念性的数学实体具有存在，因而是柏拉图主义者，也因此是唯心主义者。
en: The

, exemplified by Frege and Russell, accepted both infinite mathematical entities and infinitory reasoning, like Cantor’s. They were Platonists, in that they accorded existence to ideal mathematical entities. Hence, they were idealists.

zh: 其次，以希尔伯特为代表的形式主义者，接受无限的数学实体作为研究对象，但力求只使用有限推理。他们不关心数学实体的存在地位。
en: Next, the
, like Hilbert, accepted infinite mathematical entities as objects of study, but sought to only use finite reasoning. The existential status of mathematical entities was not of concern.

zh: 最后，直觉主义者采取了最激进的立场。他们以克罗内克为基础，诉诸数学直觉，在数学和元数学中都只接受有限构造。他们还拒斥排中律（LEM），即某事及其否定不可能同时为真。
en: Finally, the

took the most radical stance. Building on Kronicker, they would only accept finite constructions in both mathematics and meta-mathematics, appealing to mathematical intuition. They also rejected the Law of the Excluded Middle (LEM), that is, that it is not possible for something and its negation to be simultaneously true.
body.review: 底本这里将排中律写成“某事及其否定不可能同时为真”；这实际上是矛盾律的表述。第7章列出的排中律是“任何事物必定或者存在，或者不存在”。正文保留底本措辞。

zh: 这些学派的拥护者之间存在深刻的分歧，有时甚至相互谩骂。尽管如此，它们的形式系统实际上联系十分紧密。
en: There were profound, and sometimes vituperative, disagreements between proponents of these different schools. Nonetheless, their formal systems were actually very closely related.

zh: 直觉主义
对康托尔的一种回应是彻底拒斥非有限性方法，实际上也拒斥实数。因此，克罗内克在1886年主张，通过操作无限序列得到的特定结果，只有能够用整数算术重建、而“不超出有限序列的概念”时，才可以接受。
en: One response to Cantor was to entirely reject non-finitary methods, and, in effect, real numbers. Thus, in 1886, Kronecker argued that particular results found by manipulating infinite sequences were only admissible if they could be reconstructed without going ‘beyond the concept of a
series’, using arithmetic over integers.

zh: 随后，吕伊岑·布劳威尔（1881—1966）的直觉主义致力于利用构造性的有限方法，从少数几个“直觉”概念出发重建形式逻辑。1908年，布劳威尔发表了对经典逻辑的批评，其中的主题在他后来的全部著作中反复出现。
首先，他认为，脱离数学的逻辑会导致无根据的结论。与形式主义者相反，布劳威尔认为逻辑应当以数学为基础，而数学本身则以观察和对基本真理的原初直觉为基础。不过，他也认为，即使独立于数学，三段论推理和归谬论证都是可接受的（第27、29页）。
en: Subsequently, Luitzen Brouwer’s (1881–1966) intuitionism was concerned with the reconstruction of formal logic from a small number of ‘intuitive’ concepts, using constructive, finite techniques. In 1908, Brouwer published a critique of classical logic, whose themes recur in all his later writing.

First of all, he thought that logic separate from mathematics led to unfounded conclusions. Against the formalists, Brouwer thought that logic should be grounded in mathemetics, itself grounded in both observation and primordial intuitions of basic truth. Nonetheless, he suggests that, independently of mathematics, argument by syllogism and contradiction are both acceptable (p27,29).

zh: 布劳威尔拒斥排中律（LEM），
即某事及其否定不可能同时为真（第29页及以下）。这意味着二者必有其一为真，不允许任何一方的地位不确定。同样，布劳威尔拒斥双重否定可以相互抵消，因为某事“并非不真”仍可能使其地位悬而未定。
en: Brouwer rejects the LEM,

that it is not possible for both something and its negation to be true (p29ff). This implies that one or other must be true, not allowing for the status of either to be uncertain. Similarly, Brouwer rejects double negation as cancelling, because something not being not true may still leave its status indeterminate.
body.review: 本段沿用上一处对排中律的误述，并由“不同时为真”转到“必有其一为真”。这两种表述不能等同；译文保留作者原有论述。

zh: 布劳威尔进一步指出，排中律
en: Brouwer further argues that LEM

zh: 要求每个假设或者正确、或者不正确。用数学语言说，对于假定的系统之间以某种方式相互嵌合的每一种情形，要么能构造出其完成，要么能构造出因不可能而受阻的情形。因此，principium tertii exclusi［即排中律］是否有效的问题，等同于是否可能存在不可解数学问题的问题。（第42页）

The question of the validity of the principium tertii exclusi [ie LEM] is thus equivalent to the question concerning the

中，明确表现出了主观主义。

zh: 从布尔什维克革命到孟什维克化的唯心主义

children: From the Bolshevik revolution to Menshevizing Idealism

zh: 20世纪头25年的灾难性事件夺去了数百万人的生命，又摧毁了数百万人的生活；要充分呈现这些事件而不显得轻描淡写，是不可能的。不过，从我们当前的视角看，1914年至1919年世界大战的关键结果，是苏联的建立。
这是第一个由明确奉行唯物主义的群众政党执政的国家。
en: It is not possible to do justice to the catastrophic events of the first quarter of the twenteith century, killing millions of people and devastating the lives of millions more, without appearing to trivialize them. Nonetheless, from our current perspective, the key outcome of the 1914 to 1919 world war was the establishment of the Soviet Union,
the first state governed by a mass party explicitly committed to materialism.

zh: 内战（1917—1923）之后，苏联把重心放在重建和立即改善人民生活上。一旦更广泛的国际革命已陷入停滞这一点变得明确，压倒一切的优先任务便是稳定和加强苏联。为了这一目标，也为了向共产主义未来迈进，科学被视为核心。
en: Following the Civil War (1917–23), the Soviet focus was on reconstruction, and immediately bettering people’s lives. Once it was clear that wider international revolution had stalled, the overwhelming priority was to stabilize and strengthen the Union. For this, and for building towards a Communist future, science was deemed central.

zh: 战争和移民造成专家短缺，因此起初只要能确保忠诚，国家就无法对剩余的非共产党知识界的意识形态正确性要求过高。与此同时，在共产党领导下不断扩大的教育体系，持续培养出新一代“红色专家”——科学家和工程师。他们明确致力于苏联的目标，却必然要与革命前的一辈人共同工作。
en: With a shortage of experts, lost through war or emigration, the state could not initially afford to place too much premium on the ideological rectitude of the remaining non-Communist intelligentsia, provided their loyalty was assured. At the same time, the expanding education system, under Communist direction, steadily produced a new generation of ‘Red expert’ scientists and engineers, who were explicitly committed to Soviet objectives, but who necessarily worked alongside the pre-Revolutionary cohorts.

zh: 数学发挥了核心作用；这一时期，莫斯科和列宁格勒发展出两个世界级数学中心。纯数学研究虽在继续，但重点在于应用数学。总体上，形式逻辑并不突出。
en: Mathematics had a central role, and this period saw the growth of two world class mathematical centres, in Moscow and Leningrad. While pure mathematics research continued, the emphasis was on applied mathematics. Overall, formal logic was not prominent.

zh: 然而，形式逻辑的地位依然存在争议，甚至在布尔什维克内部围绕苏联发展方向的两极分化中也是如此。例如，1921年，列宁
在讨论托洛茨基的工会提案时，批评布哈林忽视辩证逻辑。
en: Nonetheless, the status of formal logic was still contested, even among polarizations within the Bolsheviks over the direction that the Soviet Union should take. For example, in 1921, Lenin,
in discussing Trotsky’s Trade Unions proposal, attacked Bukharin for his neglect of dialectical logic.

zh: 1924年列宁去世后，布尔什维克不同派别之间的斗争变得尖锐。这些斗争以新经济政策（NEP）为背景：新经济政策违背社会主义的愿望，引入相当大的市场成分，试图在战时共产主义这一务实的指令经济所带来的困境之后，加快经济恢复。过度简化地说，“左”派主张迅速从新经济政策转向计划经济，“右”派则主张较慢的转变。这些斗争还与争夺地位、清算旧账深深交织在一起。
en: After Lenin’s death in 1924, the struggles between different Bolshevik factions became acute. These took place against the background of the New Economic Policy (NEP), which, contrary to socialist aspirations, had introduced a substantial market component to try to accelerate recovery following the exigences of the pragmatic command economy of War Communism. To over simplify, the ‘left’ faction promoted a speedy transition from the NEP to a planned economy, whereas the ‘right’ faction sought a slower change. And these struggles were deeply entangled with jockeying for position and settling of scores.

zh: 正如海伦娜·希恩
系统考察的那样，科学与哲学的关系在意识形态和实践两个层面，都成为这些争论的重要组成部分。由此形成两种立场。一方质疑辩证法与科学的相关性，符合亚里士多德传统：成熟的科学独立于其辩证法根源而自主发展。反对者把这一立场称为机械论，认为它源于马克思和恩格斯曾反对的机械唯物主义。另一方则重新强调辩证法，似乎符合汲取黑格尔思想的马克思主义主流传统。
en: As Helena Sheehan

systematically explores, the relationship of science to philosophy became an important component of these disputes, at both ideological and practical levels. Two positions developed. On the one side, the relevance of dialectics to science was questioned. This was in keeping with the Aristotelian tradition that mature sciences developed autonomously of their dialectical roots. This position was characterized by opponents as mechanist, descended from the mechanical materialism that Marx and Engels had opposed. On the other side, was a renewed emphasis on dialectics. This appeared to be in keeping with the mainstream Marxist tradition, drawing on Hegel.

zh: 起初，科学话语内部的意识形态斗争针对的是“右”倾，它在论战措辞中被称为孟什维克倾向。在这里，德波林领导的辩证法派在与机械论派的斗争中占了上风。在数学领域，这导致形式逻辑受到越来越强烈的拒斥。辩证法派的优势没有维持多久。在随后反对“左”倾的斗争中，对辩证法的过度依赖被称为唯心主义。正如弗里德曼后来在那篇标题颇能说明问题的《苏联反对形式主义的反叛》
中所写：
en: Initially, ideological struggles within scientific discourse were against the ‘right’ tendency, characterized rhetorically as Menshevik. Here, the dialecticians under Deborin gained the upper hand against the mechanists. Within mathematics, this led to an increased repudiation of formal logic. The dialecticians’ ascendancy was short lived. During subsequent struggles against the ‘left’ tendency, an over dependence on dialectics was characterized as idealist. As Friedmann subsequently wrote in the telling titled

children: Revolt Against Formalism in the Soviet Union

zh: 但是，机械论的批评者被热情冲昏头脑，走向了另一个极端——唯心主义。这就需要党的理论家所说的“两条战线上的斗争”。显然，在这里也是实践中的失误引起了对理论问题的注意。（第307页）
en: But the critics of mechanism, carried away by their zeal, fell into the opposite extreme of idealism. This required a ‘struggle on two fronts’ as the theoreticians of the Party call it. Apparently it was faults in practice which here too called attention to the theoretical problems. (p307)

zh: 然而，这一倾向的失败并没有使逻辑得到恢复。相反，两种立场都被混同为孟什维克化的唯心主义，苏联的形式逻辑日益停滞，直到20世纪50年代初。
en: However, the defeat of this tendency did not result in the rehabilitation of logic. Rather, both positions were conflated as

zh: 孟什维克化的唯心主义与逻辑
杰出的数学家安德烈·柯尔莫哥洛夫（1903—1987）是新一代红色专家的代表。他1925年的论文《论排中律》
批评了形式主义和直觉主义，但也表明，经典逻辑与直觉主义逻辑可以在直觉主义框架内得到调和。
en: The outstanding mathematician Andrei Kolmogorov (1903–87) exemplified the new generation of Red experts. His 1925 paper

children: On the principle of the excluded middle

en: offered a critique of formalism and intuitionism, but also showed how classical and intuitionist logic might be reconciled, within an intuitionist framework.

zh: 布劳威尔曾主张，用排中律和超限前提来确立有限性结果是不正当的。柯尔莫哥洛夫证明，即使不诉诸这二者，这类有限性结果仍然成立。
en: Brouwer had argued that it was illegitimate to use both the LEM and transfinite premises to establish finitary results. Kolmogorov demonstrated that such finitary results still stood without recourse to either.

zh: 柯尔莫哥洛夫与直觉主义者一样，认为在没有其他证据时，相互矛盾的项应被视为未定。他也与直觉主义者一样，质疑超限前提是否有意义，即使它们能够用来得到有限性结果。
en: With the intuitionists, Kolmogorov accepted that, in the absence of other evidence, contradictory terms should be regarded as indeterminate. Further, with the intuitionists, he questioned whether transfinite premises had any meaning, even if they might be used to reach finitary results.

zh: 柯尔莫哥洛夫把形式主义描述为不对前提的选择作出承诺，听起来与亚里士多德的辩证法相近。他指出，可以把对立项之一增加为公理来解决矛盾，并观察到，从形式主义的角度看：
en: Kolmogorov’s characterization of formalism, as uncommitted to choice of premises, sounds akin to Aristotelian dialectics. Noting that a contradiction may be resolved by adding one of the opposed terms as an axiom, he observed that, from a formalist perspective:

zh: 因此，从每一对相互矛盾的公式中选出一个作为新公理，只需考虑是否方便。（第417页）
en: The selection of the formula taken as the new axiom, from each pair of contradictory formulas, is thus subject only to considerations of convenience. (p417)

zh: 此外，形式主义逻辑不赋予公理任何意义，而直觉主义则以“表达给予我们的事实”的公理为基础（第417页）。这是黑格尔的、也是辩证唯物主义的立场，即一种统一的、有内容的逻辑。然而，柯尔莫哥洛夫仍将“数理逻辑”视为数学中一个独立的组成部分。在这里，他并未采取一种明确带有派别立场的哲学姿态，而是采取数学的立场。
en: Further, while formalist logic attributed no meaning to axioms, intutionism was based on axioms that ‘express facts given to us’ (p417). This is the Hegelian, and also dialectical materialist, position of an integrated, content-full logic. However, Kolmogorov still identified ‘mathematical logic’ as a distinct component of mathematics. Here, Kolmogorov did not take an explicitly partisan philosophical, as opposed to mathematical, stance.

zh: 然而，正如武西尼奇

所考察的，就在同一年，即1925年，苏联的意识形态家在哲学期刊《在马克思主义旗帜下》明确攻击支撑康托尔成果的唯心主义。武西尼奇指出，当时没有人试图寻找一种唯物主义的替代方案来取代康托尔的理论（第117—118页）；虽然希尔伯特受到的关注较少，辩证逻辑却被置于形式逻辑的对立面（第118—119页）。不过，这些攻击针对康托尔的集合论，而非苏联数学家（第122页）。曾属列宁格勒学派的数学家G. G. 洛伦兹
指出，同一时期，基辅的一个代数学派在乌克兰共产党指示下被关闭，其学者分散到其他中心。
en: However, as Vucinich
explores, in that same year of 1925, Soviet ideologues explicitly attacked the idealism underpinning Cantor’s results in the philosophical journal

. Vucinich notes that no attempt was made to find a materialist alternative to Cantor (p117–8), and that, while less attention was paid to Hilbert, dialectical logic was counterpoised to formal logic (p118– 9). Nonetheless, the attacks were against Cantor’s set theory rather than Soviet mathematicians (p122). The former Leningrad School mathematician G. G. Lorentz
notes that, in the same period, an algebraic school in Kiev was closed, under the direction of the Ukrainian Communist Party, and its scholars dispersed to other centres.

zh: 1931年，红色专家恩斯特·科尔曼（1892—1979）和索菲娅·亚诺夫斯卡娅（1896—1966）在同样发表于《在马克思主义旗帜下》的《黑格尔与数学》中，明确阐述了辩证唯物主义的立场。
他们反复引用《反杜林论》和不久前问世的《自然辩证法》，在批评黑格尔辩证法的同时，强调辩证唯物主义根植于黑格尔。
en: The Red experts Ernst Kolman (1892–1979) and Sofya Yanovskaya (1896– 1966) provided a clear statement of the dialectical materialist position in 1931, in

zh: 科尔曼和亚诺夫斯卡娅概述并拒斥了上述逻辑学派：直觉主义依赖先验假定；逻辑主义把逻辑与数学统一起来，将理性规律等同于公理和定理；形式主义则脱离内容处理逻辑。他们还拒斥把数学视为物理学一部分的“机械论经验主义者”，并反对马赫将问题心理学化。总的说来：
en: Kolman and Yanovskaya summarized and rejected the schools of logic we identified above: intuitionism for depending on

assumptions; logicism for unifying logic and mathematics, and identifying the laws of reason with axioms and theorems; and formalism for treating logic independetly of content. They further reject ‘mechanistic empiricists’ who see mathematics as part of physics, and Mach for psychologizing. Overall:

zh: 因此，这些哲学学派都只抓住现实的一个方面，没有任何一个能够理解数学与实践的联系及其发展规律。只有黑格尔给数学下了一个把握事物本质的定义；这个定义完全独立于黑格尔的观点，实际上是深刻唯物主义的。
en: Thus none of these philosophical schools, which all grasp one and only one side of reality, is in a position to understand the link between mathematics and practice and its laws of development. Hegel alone gave mathematics a definition such as grasped the essence of the matter, a definition which, quite independently of Hegel’s views, is actually profoundly materialist.

zh: 不过，从阶级立场看待数学，并不意味着拒斥数学：
en: Nonetheless, taking a class standpoint on mathematics does not involve rejecting it:

zh: 恰恰相反，它［资产阶级数学］必须经过重构，因为它虽然片面而歪曲，却仍客观地表现了物质世界。
en: on the contrary it [bourgeois mathematics] must be subjected to a reconstruction, since it represents the material world, albeit one-sidedly and distortedly, nevertheless objectively.

zh: 科尔曼和亚诺夫斯卡娅指出，试图把分析还原为算术，最终导致了

en: the well-known paradoxes of set theory which destroyed the whole structure, not only of mathematical but also logical (sic), which had been specially erected for that purpose.

zh: 因此，尽管理由截然不同，他们与直觉主义者一样，对康托尔的无限持怀疑态度。
en: Thus, though for very different reasons, they shared the intuitionist suspicion of Cantor’s infinities.

zh: 当时，亚诺夫斯卡娅正在翻译和编辑新近重新发现的马克思数学手稿；这些手稿于1933年出版。
马克思在讨论泰勒定理时写道：
en: At the time, Yanovskaya was translating and editing Marx’s recently rediscovered manuscripts on mathematics, which appeared in 1933.
In discussing Taylor’s theorem, Marx wrote:

zh: 这种从普通代数出发、而且借助普通代数，跃入变量代数的飞跃，被当作既成事实；它没有得到证明，乍看之下还与通常代数的一切规律相矛盾。……换句话说，起始方程……不仅没有得到证明，而且实际上有意无意地假定了以变量替代常量，这公然违背代数的一切规律——因为代数，因而也包括代数二项式，只容许常量，而且只有两种常量：已知的和未知的。因此，从代数推导这个方程，似乎建立在欺骗之上。（第117页）

zh: 这仿佛表明，马克思只能接受变量作为实际存在的值的占位符，而不能接受它作为一般的值的占位符。这种思想混乱触及黑格尔对逻辑形式主义批评的核心：把逻辑的内容——这里是常量——抽象成变量，再以任意值替换这些变量，被视为不正当。上面提到的恩格斯关于变量和抽象的断言，很可能源自他与马克思的讨论。
en: It is as if Marx can only accept variables as place holders for actually existing values, rather than for values in general. This muddleheadedness gets to the heart of the Hegelian critique of formalism in logic: that it is illegitimate to remove content from logic, here constants, by abstraction to variables, which may in turn be replaced by arbitrary values. Engels’ assertions about variables and abstraction, noted above, may well derive from discussions with Marx.

zh: 当然，只要明确说明这种抽象，对方程中的任意常量乃至公式作抽象，都是完全正当的。
然而，科尔曼和亚诺夫斯卡娅引用马克思时，并未进一步评论。
en: Of course it is perfectly legitimate to abstract over any constants, or indeed formulae, in an equation, provided such abstraction is made explicit.
However, Kolman and Yanovskaya quote Marx without further comment.

zh: 1932年，柯尔莫哥洛夫探索了一条辩证唯物主义能够接受的直觉主义进路。在《论直觉主义逻辑的解释》
中，他将直觉主义逻辑重新表述为问题演算，并证明它在形式上等价于海廷对布劳威尔逻辑的形式化。柯尔莫哥洛夫巧妙地把焦点放在植根于现实的问题上，从而避开了对无内容形式的批评，以及对用变量概括常量的批评：
en: In 1932, Kolmogorov explored an approach to intuitionism that was acceptable to dialectical materialism. In

and showed that it is formally equivalent to Heyting’s formalization of Brouwer’s logic. Cunningly, Kolmogorov avoided the critique of form without content and that of variables generalizing constants, by focusing on problems, which are grounded in reality:

zh: 直觉主义逻辑应由问题演算来取代，因为它的对象实际上不是理论命题，而是问题。（第328页）
en: intuitionistic logic should be replaced by the calculus of problems, for its objects are in reality not theoretical propositions but rather problems. (p328)

zh: 也就是说：
en: That is:

zh: 在数学各个具体领域出现的一切情形中，都能使用“问题”和“问题的解”这两个概念，而不会引起误解。（第329页）
en: the concepts ‘problem’ and ‘solution of a problem’ can be employed without misunderstanding in all cases that occur in the concrete areas of mathematics. (p329)

zh: 这一障眼法，用对具体问题的抽象替代了对前提的抽象。
en: This slight of hand substitutes abstraction over concrete problems for abstraction over premises.

zh: 有趣的是，柯尔莫哥洛夫把其逻辑的规则称为“计算性的”（第334页）。把数学视为计算，是我们的唯物主义观念的核心。
en: Interestingly, Kolmogorov refers to the rules of his logic as ‘computational’ (p334). The idea of mathematics as computation is central to our conception of materialism.

zh: 因此，直觉主义成为苏联构造逻辑学派的基础。具有讽刺意味的是，构造主义如今已成为编程语言理论与实践的一种核心进路。
en: Thus, intuitionism was the foundation of the Soviet school of constructive logic. Ironically, constructivism is now a core approach for the theory and practice of programming languages.

zh: 孟什维克化的唯心主义与英国马克思主义
英国共产党（CPGB）成立于1920年。作为一个马克思列宁主义政党，该党明确与苏联共产党保持一致，并倡导辩证唯物主义世界观。它虽从未像其他西欧共产党那样拥有众多党员或取得选举成功，却在工会中有相当大的影响力。
en: The Communist Party of Great Britain (CPGB) was formed in 1920. A Marxist-Leninist party, the CPGM was explicitly aligned with the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and promoted the dialectical materialist world view.
